Memory.title: Memory
Memory.description: A saved romantic response and interaction record left by Marie (or Edwin) at the end of the experience.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the authenticated user who created this memory.

replyMessage.description: Heartfelt message written at the end of the experience.

noAttemptsCount.description: Total number of times the evasive No button was attempted across all stages.

favoriteMoment.description: Selected favorite stage from the experience.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the memory was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the memory was last updated.

/memories/{memoryId}.description: Stores saved responses and interaction summaries created by authenticated users.
